description.value:
You seize a creature you touch and attempt to crush it. It must succeed on a Strength saving throw — with disadvantage if it is grappled or restrained by you or an effect you control — or take 1d12 kinetic damage.

The damage increases to 2d12 at 5th level, 3d12 at 11th level, and 4d12 at 17th level.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Tech Powers, At-Will
